note: Massachusetts law puts a Veterans Service Officer in every city and town. Find yours with the state’s Find Your Local VSO search (by city, town or ZIP code), call your town hall and ask for Veterans’ Services, or call the Executive Office of Veterans Services and ask for your VSO. Chapter 115 benefits are applied for through your local VSO. Veterans Service Officers help with state benefits, including Chapter 115, and referrals to federal VA help.
